notes.title: Patch Notes for April 30th
notes.content:
Hello again!  Good sized update for today.  Thanks again for those who are enjoying the game!

-Fixed getting the box right away if you pressed Start in "Castle Rescue"
-Fixed the blackjack dealer repeating himself if you pressed "A" when you push against the dealer
-Fixed Spurdo's name not being displayed in some dialogue
-Reworked a few collisions
-Fixed the boat going fast if you tried moving before you went back to fishing
-Fixed going fast with the box in "Castle Rescue" if you got caught with it on (decided to fix it after all)
-Reworked Goblins in "Castle Rescue" so the ones guarding the side doors are on a timer rather than being random
-Made the drinking effect last longer in "The drunken"
-Fixed not being able to talk to people after you pressed the start button in "The Search"
-Added evidence counter on table in "The Drunken"
-Gave a slight increase to the % chance of catching a better fish, if you catch the lowest tier fish several times
-Changed the UI in the weightlifting competition to match the direction placement with the move set
-Fixed misc. spelling mistakes

And most importantly, nearly 20 achievements have been added!

Special thanks to "nosharko" for their in depth running around that allowed me to see new bugs I didn't catch!

notes.title: Patch notes for April 18th
notes.content:
-Fixed infinite +max HP item bug in "The Very Best" world
-Fixed issue where Spurdo using the "Cry" move would instantly kill the opponent in "The Very Best" world
-Fixed weird bug where Spurdo would freak out and move in all directions extremely fast in "Castle Rescue"(hopefully fixed, anyway)
-Fixed continued walking animation in "The Drunken" when you use the elevator
-Fixed dialogue not changing in "Fire in the Sky" at the top of the hill if you rapidly press A while going to the next characters dialogue.
-Other small fixes

I think those seem to be the rest of the issues found and solved, but I'll continue monitoring comments if people find new issues I didn't discover.

I'll be working on some Quality of Life adjustments this next week.

notes.title: April 15th patch notes that include yesterday:
notes.content:
-Added button prompts that change depending on if you're using keyboard or controller (Sorry this took awhile, for you keyboard users)
-Fixed a little delay with Spurdo's animation in "Castle Rescue" where his walking animation wouldn't play for a short time after capturing a bug, and he could still catch a bug shortly after he finished using the bottle.
-Kept the Spurdo box bug in "Castle Rescue" for now since it's kind of funny and doesn't really affect anything
-Fixed a few spelling errors, some of which I have no idea how I missed.
-Fixed being able to punch in "The Very Best", where if you paused when you went in the level, then un-paused, you were able to punch before obtaining that ability.
-Adjusted the arrows on the telescope to make them less prominent when you can't move left or right.
-Changed the graphic indicator for going back to heaven in "The Very Best" world so it's more obvious and not just a blank white space.
-Fixed the sudden change in screen color when you get the "You remember" message after you beat "Fire in the Sky"
-Added a little text to the bottom right whenever you bring up the main menu, indicating you can go back by pressing "B" ("C" on keyboard")
-Got rid of the cursor appearing after the last update
-Fixed a leftover collision trigger from when you reach the final scene that would send you out of it and back to the hub
-Lowered the blur a bit on the cut scenes
-Other random small fixes

Also, the comments about the game are really nice so far, and it's interesting to hear which worlds people like the most.  Just want to say I'm very glad that people are enjoying it!

notes.title: First day Patch notes.
notes.content:
-First day updates:

-Fixed pretty bad bug which where if you finished "Fire in the sky" and went back into it, and then went into another world, and tried to get back to heaven, it would soft lock on you.  Thanks to those who provided me details about their experience that helped me find the issue.

-Eliminated left over inputs which would lead to being unable to talk to angels in heaven

-Updated UI for "Castle Rescue" to fit in line with the style.

-Some of the characters in "Fire in the sky" were there  on the bench even if you didn't talk to them.

-Assorted small fixes.

I'm still working on correcting things and making some quality of life improvements, as soon as I iron out the various little bugs.

Thank you SO much for those who liked the game by the way, it means a lot!
